Exactly tameshi round 19 attempt 1, BUILD advisory wave. L1 holds frozen planner and sole production integration writer. One declared claim C1 CALIBRATION (tied lowest owned axis depth=8/calibration=8): five routed round-18 metadata/receipt defects move from 0/5 durably corrected to 5/5, measured on frozen baseline 7243e7f163f08978c8fd9b6c1ef67a2fefe7d190 and delivered lane revision by a failure-capable audit. Numeric calibration remains 8 (no promotion or new cold-read coverage claimed); measure defects, not an invented score. No other claim. Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/corpus/lessons/round-18-verifier-spotcheck.md §5. Existing 18 guard survivors remain explicitly open unless assigned otherwise; no expansion claim.
# Contract
All lane paths absolute beneath /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Read-only seats return findings, not production edits. All seats may write ONLY their unique Report trailer at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that relative path>. A Report: trailer is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin, NEVER fleet cwd. No seat changes production, Git/JJ refs/index/state, fleet, siblings, private configs, secrets, accounts/vault, host/packages/services/compositor/boot, or domain trees. No subprocess git writes except isolated /tmp scratch with GIT_* removed; do not run lane selftests, builds/lints/tests/formatters mid-flight. Executors may run bounded new investigation code in /tmp and attach code text in report; no shared scratch. No delegation/background jobs. Tools/routing session-owned; never set a model or inspect private routing. Useful official tool installs authorized after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md, report tool/version/channel/reason; all pacman transactions and host upgrades PAUSED. Prefer no installs. Scratch /tmp disposable or /fast/scratch multi-day; no heavy HOME/devshm/global env. No third-party exploitation. No arbitrary execution of receipt argv. Prior reports/evidence preserved; corrections append dated named errata. Findings are advisory, never independent closure. Return concise evidence and concrete failing criterion, distinguish observation/inference/unknown. Sources must be opened honestly; quote <=25 words with location and date. Every task serves C1 or its no-harm/source/verification boundary.
